facts.value: Designed as a joint honours degree, the BA in Law and Accounting offers you a full law degree and full accounting degree. Because at this stage, you may not know what career you would like to pursue, the BA Law and Accounting degree allows you to pursue either career, while using skills from both disciplines to enhance your chosen professional career path.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Law and Accounting at UL?

facts.value: A strong legal background assists the work of many accounting specialists and a firm grounding in all aspects of accounting, including taxation, deepens the lawyer’s understanding of business transactions.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Law and Accounting at UL?

facts.value: The combination allows you to make your choice of profession when you have a better knowledge of your strengths and of the law and accounting disciplines.
